playstyle.identity: Renata Glasc is a manipulative enchanter who can revive allies briefly and make enemies attack each other. Her ultimate turns teamfights chaotic.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive empowers ally attacks. Q fires a missile that roots (or pulls two things together). W gives ally attack/move speed - if they die, they revive briefly as zombie. E damages and shields in a line. R sends a wave that makes enemies berserk (attack allies). W saves carries, R to flip teamfights.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Renata spikes at level 6 with her teamfight-flipping R. Shurelya's and support items scale her. She's strong at clutch saves and teamfight disruption.

strengths: R makes enemies attack each other

passive.name: Leverage
passive.summary: Ally attacks on enemies you damage deal bonus damage.
passive.details: Renata's basic attacks mark enemies. Allied champions' attacks against marked enemies deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: Handshake
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that roots; hitting a second target pulls them together.
abilities.details: Renata fires a missile that roots the first enemy hit. She can recast to throw them in a direction, stunning if they hit terrain or another enemy.

abilities.name: Bailout
abilities.summary: Buff ally's attack and move speed; if they die, briefly revive them.
abilities.details: Renata grants an ally bonus attack speed and movement speed. If they take fatal damage, they briefly become a zombie. Getting a takedown saves them permanently.

abilities.name: Loyalty Program
abilities.summary: Send missiles that damage enemies and shield allies.
abilities.details: Renata sends chemtech missiles that shield allies and damage enemies in a line.

abilities.name: Hostile Takeover
abilities.summary: Send a wave that makes enemies go berserk, attacking their allies.
abilities.details: Renata sends a wave of chemicals that causes enemies to go berserk, gaining attack speed but being forced to attack their own allies. They prioritize champions over everything else.
